title: LLM-as-a-Supervisor: Mistaken Therapeutic Behaviors Trigger Targeted Supervisory Feedback
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLMs to identify ethical breaches and social biases (such as gender stereotyping and cultural insensitivity) within therapeutic dialogues. It incorporates 'ethicality' as a specific validation criterion for its supervisor model and includes 'breaches of ethical standards' as a core category of identified mistakes.
